title: Property
description: Defines a property with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced progression systems.

name.description: The display name of the property.

era.description: The primary era this property is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: How common or unique this property is in the galaxy.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the property, its significance, and role. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this property, often from Star Wars lore.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this property is viewed by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Detailed mechanical and lore description of the property.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this property in the galaxy.

application_tags.description: A list of tags an item must have for this property to be applied.

effects.description: A list of mechanical effects this property provides.

type.description: The type of effect this property provides.

value.description: The value associated with this effect (varies by type).

target_property.description: The property being modified (for modify_stat effects).

target_scopes.description: The scope of targets this effect applies to.

conditions.description: Conditions that must be met for this effect to apply.

actions.description: Actions that can be taken with this effect.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Applied_To', 'Developed_By', 'Restricted_To', 'Iconic_To'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this property type from Star Wars canon.

famous_properties.description: Notable properties of this type from Star Wars lore.

homeworld.description: The primary homeworld or origin of this property.

cultural_notes.description: Important cultural information about this property.

roleplay_guidance.description: Guidance for roleplaying with this property.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements specific to this property.

social_dynamics.description: How this property affects social dynamics in the galaxy.

common_motivations.description: Common motivations and goals for using this property.

property_development.description: Guidance for property development and progression.

base_prompt.description: Base prompt for generating images of this property.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers for different contexts and situations.

target_type.description: The type of image being generated (e.g., 'Portrait', 'Action_Shot', 'Property_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Additional text to add to the prompt for this context.

image.description: Path to the property image file.

icon.description: Path to the property icon file.

color.description: Primary color associated with this property for UI theming.
